fixture: SYNTHETIC_VALIDITY_SCHEDULE over the NON_SCORED_TEST_FIXTURE_M1 non-GPS carrier

P0_ALL_VALID.role: NULL CONTROL. No observation is ever invalid, so nothing can be masked and the gate must never close.

P1_SINGLE_BURST.role: One contiguous invalid interval of commanded duration d. The sweep varies d across the predicted boundary.

P2_PERIODIC_INTERLEAVE.role: n_invalid rejected messages for every n_valid accepted one, repeating. High invalid DENSITY, short invalid INTERVALS.

P3_RANDOM_DROPOUT.role: Each message independently invalid with probability p. Fixed seed, so the realised schedule is reproducible.

P4_CLUSTERED_BURSTS.role: Repeated invalid bursts, each shorter than the timeout, separated by a single accepted message.

P5_PERMANENT.role: NULL CONTROL at the other extreme. Invalid from onset to the end of the recording: the gate MUST close, exactly one timeout after the last accepted sample.

scope: gate only; payload is constant, so trust and posterior numbers are not reported from this fixture
